name: smwsprites-spinning-log
title: Spinning Log
description:
A wooden platform encountered in Yoshi's Island that quickly rotates periodically, throwing the player on contact.

Extra bit is used to determine the rotating interval like this: Spinning Logs with extra bit clear rotates when Spinning Logs with extra bit set don't and viceversa.

Originally from smkdan's Yoshi's Island dynamic sprite pack.
